findings.issue: contradicts task clause "R13 (low): give the counter a short view name with no nested brackets": the diff gives the counter no view name at all - it now reads '5 of 7 phases in view'. The phase outcome is 'the counter names its basis', and the basis was the view; #audit-count is aria-live=polite, so the announcement a screen reader hears no longer says which view it counts in, only that a view exists. The gate's at-rest check dropped `rest[3] === label` and now holds the counter only to the literal words 'in view' plus the select existing, so nothing checks that the count names the view any more. The executor's reason (short names misname 'Active & pending', and 'Active & pending' alone wanted 224px against ~173 free) was measured before the same diff gave #audit-count `flex:1 1 6rem;min-width:0;line-height:1.25`, which lets the count wrap its own words inside the row's height. That change takes away the width argument.
findings.resolution: Carry a short, bracket-free view name per option (e.g. a data-short on each <option>: 'active & pending', 'archived', 'all'), and render it into the count without brackets ('5 of 7 phases · active & pending', or '5 of 7 active & pending phases'). Restore the gate's at-rest check that the name in the count is the selected option's short name, and keep nw1 holding the 1512x945 bar to one line. Bring c5b into step.

findings.issue: es0 counts a kind of press as covered once it is recorded in `truth.out`, and the search and from/to presses' `on()` always return true. So a search press that no longer filters (Enter's keydown no longer calling refresh()) or a date press that does nothing (the change listeners on #audit-from/#audit-to removed) still turns es0 green. The test asserts that a press was made, not that it was effective.
findings.resolution: Record per press whether it narrowed anything (drawn rows below the view's resting count, or the toolbar's Clear shown), and require each kind in `kinds` to have at least one press that did. Prove that red by making the search press set the value without dispatching Enter.
